description: This file implements the StateTransitionHandler class, which manages state transition requests in a multi-threaded environment. It includes thread management, synchronization primitives, and methods for initializing, terminating, and adding requests to handle state changes within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: StateTransitionHandler
classes.description: Manages state transition requests, ensuring thread-safe handling and state changes within the plugin.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StateTransitionHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the handler, starts the request processing thread, and sets up synchronization primitives.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Stops the request processing thread and cleans up resources.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a new state transition request to the queue for processing.
